sources.title: BDUK Delivery Performance Annual: April 2025 to March 2026
facts: The annual release is official statistics covering BDUK-subsidised delivery in 2025/26.
Official statistics delivery is distinct from monthly contract-management snapshots.

sources.title: Bulletin: BDUK Delivery Performance Annual April 2025 to March 2026
facts: The bulletin reports 192,570 premises delivered in 2025/26 and describes revisions.
The bulletin identifies known issues and does not provide a live orderability service.

sources.title: QMI for BDUK Delivery Performance Annual April 2025 to March 2026
sources.lines: data methods, validation, classification and accuracy sections
facts: The QMI documents source data, validation, matching and revision methods.
The QMI is used as a parcel-promotion gate rather than as parcel evidence.

sources.title: Pre-release Access List: BDUK Annual April 2025 to March 2026
facts: The page records privileged pre-release access for an official statistics publication.
No parcel or service claim is derived from an access list.

sources.title: BDUK Delivery Performance Quarterly: October to December 2025
facts: The release covers BDUK-subsidised delivery from October through December 2025.
Quarterly statistics are not conflated with monthly contracted-and-built data.

sources.title: Bulletin: BDUK Delivery Performance Quarterly October to December 2025
facts: The bulletin reports a defined quarterly reference period and cumulative programme totals.
Quarterly aggregates are not promoted to exact parcel service.

sources.title: QMI for BDUK Delivery Performance Quarterly October to December 2025
facts: The quarterly QMI describes data sources, methods and quality characteristics.
Methodology limitations remain attached to all derived candidates.

sources.title: Pre-release Access List: BDUK Quarterly October to December 2025
facts: The page documents controlled early access to the quarterly official statistics.
It contains no parcel-level availability evidence.

sources.title: BDUK Delivery Performance Quarterly: April to September 2025
facts: The release covers the first two quarters of financial year 2025/26.
Reference period and release version are retained in lineage.

sources.title: Bulletin: BDUK Delivery Performance Quarterly April to September 2025
facts: The bulletin reports Q1 and Q2 2025/26 delivery and cumulative programme estimates.
Release figures are aggregate programme evidence, not parcel orderability.

sources.title: QMI for BDUK Delivery Performance Quarterly April to September 2025
facts: The QMI records a correction removing hubs subsidised by other public bodies.
Corrections are preserved and earlier totals are not silently reused.

sources.title: Pre-release Access List: BDUK Quarterly April to September 2025
facts: The page records controlled pre-release access for the November 2025 publication.
No connectivity candidate is promoted from this page.

sources.title: BDUK Delivery Performance Annual: April 2024 to March 2025
facts: The release covers BDUK-subsidised delivery during financial year 2024/25.
Its values retain their historical reference period.

sources.title: QMI for BDUK Delivery Performance Annual April 2024 to March 2025
facts: The QMI documents UPRN validation, postcode caps and source limitations.
The document strengthens lineage and prevents unsupported parcel promotion.
